cards.problem: Constraint arrives mid-workflow; rerun checks before committing an outcome.
cards.test: Changed rule after query 1, old observation cannot silently remain current.

cards.problem: Hidden state is needed to proceed.
cards.test: Select a discriminating authorized query rather than invent a state.

cards.problem: First error goes unnoticed through a long run.
cards.test: Retain chronological action+observation receipts and detect first disagreement.

cards.problem: A passing final output hides damaging intermediate action.
cards.test: Score unintended effects independently from end state.

cards.problem: Proposed policy rewrite overfits the development benchmark.
cards.test: Frozen external holdouts and rolling back when verified utility declines.

cards.problem: More supervision costs more than saved work.
cards.test: Count human decisions, queries, retries, time and false successes.

cards.problem: Counterpart changes the shared state while agent decides.
cards.test: Independent source revision reopens stale hypotheses.

cards.problem: Agent mistakes intended button press for observed completion.
cards.test: Separate attempted action from verified external state change.

cards.problem: Task fails because prerequisite is absent.
cards.test: Do not declare impossibility until an allowed enabling action is considered.

cards.problem: Action sequence completes but physical outcome does not.
cards.test: Outcome verifier must attest gain, not merely action syntax.
Compare native evidence preservation with strong A* and Dijkstra controls.
Detect feedback-free cycles and query missing preconditions.

cards.problem: Two worlds look identical under an insufficient probe vocabulary.
cards.test: Generate candidate new questions; validate against independently computed properties.

cards.problem: False source provenance causes a wrong confident answer.
cards.test: Reject altered receipts; do not equate hashing with real-world source authentication.
